why: Which of the six playable regions a country belongs to. Upstream reports one `Americas` region, so `americasSouth` is the list that splits it: a code in it becomes South America, every other Americas country becomes North America. `overrides` then wins outright, and holds the placement of the transcontinental states — an editorial call, not a fact: Russia plays in Europe, Turkey, Cyprus, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan and Kazakhstan in Asia. `missingUpstream` covers a country the fetcher has no record of.
